official.description_text:
Research assistant in decision and control systems
Apply for position
KTH Royal Institute of Technology, School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
Job description
We are now seeking a research assistant for a paid, fixed-term position lasting 6 months at KTH’s Department of Decision and Control Systems. We welcome applications from people in the beginning of their career who wish to contribute to research projects, for example through laboratory work, compilation of experimental data, and other related tasks.
Qualifications
Requirements
Post-secondary education in software development, information systems, or computer engineering, for example from a college, university, or higher vocational education.
Experience with React, TypeScript, C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, Python, SQL (PostgreSQL), Docker, Docker Compose and Git.
You must be fluent in English both in writing and orally as it is required in the daily work.
Ability to work independently and have no problem collaborating with others.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with the traffic simulator SUMO (e.g. netconvert, randomTrips, FCD output).
Experience with geospatial data and tools (geopandas, Shapely, QGIS, OpenStreetMap, coordinate reference systems).
Basic knowledge of wireless communication and base stations (path loss, SINR, data rate requirements).
Experience with WebSockets, REST APIs, and asynchronous programming.
Experience with Swedish open data APIs (Trafikverket, Stockholm stad) and ability to read Swedish.
Pedagogic skills
Good ability to express yourself orally and in writing
Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills.
Join us at KTH
KTH shapes the future through education, research and innovation. As a leading international technical university, we play an active role in advancing the transition towards a sustainable society. At KTH, you have the opportunity to grow and develop in a creative and dynamic environment, with good working conditions and attractive benefits. Equality, diversity and equal opportunities are essential to quality and form an integral part of KTH’s core values as a university and public authority.
Learn more about our benefits and what it's like to work and grow at KTH.
Trade union representatives

trade union representatives.
To apply for the position
Log into KTH's recruitment system to apply for this position. As an applicant, you are responsible for ensuring that your application is complete when submitted and that the qualifications we request in the advertisement are clearly stated in your CV.
your application must include:
CV including relevant professional experience and knowledge.
Copy of diplomas and grades from your previous university studies. Translations into English or Swedish if the original documents have not been issued in any of these languages.
Brief account of why you want to conduct research, your academic interests and how they relate to your previous studies and future goals. Maximally two page long.
Your complete application must be received by KTH no later than the last day of application, midnight CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).
About the employment
The employment is valid for a limited time according to the agreement - for up to 6 months, with access according to agreement.
Other information
Striving towards gender equality, diversity and equal conditions is both a question of quality for KTH and a given part of our values.

ai.summary: Six-month research assistant position at KTH's Department of Decision and Control Systems, focused on software development tasks (React, TypeScript, C#, ASP.NET Core, Python, SQL, Docker) for traffic simulation and geospatial data integration projects. Entry-level position for early-career technicians.

thematic_fit.rationale: No thematic alignment. The position is a software development support role for traffic control systems, not a research role in HCI, immersive systems, spatial cognition, or learning. The domain (decision and control systems for traffic) is entirely orthogonal to the researcher's target identity.

methodological_fit.rationale: Limited and indirect methodological fit. The role is primarily technical implementation (full-stack web development, database work, Docker containerization) rather than research methodology. While the researcher has intermediate C# and Unity skills, the position requires web-stack technologies (React, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework) that differ substantially. Geospatial data tools (geopandas, QGIS) and traffic simulation (SUMO) are unfamiliar domains. This is engineering work, not HCI or experimental research.

growth_value.rationale: Growth is narrowly technical and misaligned with research trajectory. Learning React, ASP.NET, and traffic simulation tools does not advance capabilities in immersive-systems design, user evaluation, spatial cognition, or collaborative learning. A 6-month assistant role provides web-development experience but no pathway to doctoral research or human-centred XR expertise.

strategic_value.rationale: This is an entry-level technical support role, not a research position. It does not serve strategic career goals (doctoral studies in HCI/XR, eventual postdoc or PI roles). KTH is a strong institution, but placement in Decision and Control Systems reinforces systems engineering rather than HCI identity. Six months of assistant work is unlikely to strengthen candidacy for target PhD positions at Aalto or TU Delft.

eligibility_flags: Position is explicitly for early-career technicians (post-secondary education), not for MSc graduates. Researcher's MSc by Research may overqualify for the role or signal misalignment.
Preferred qualifications (SUMO, geospatial tools, WebSockets, REST APIs, Swedish language) are not demonstrated in researcher's profile.
Six-month contract is very short; minimal time for meaningful research contribution or skill consolidation.
Role involves laboratory work and experimental data compilation, not independent research design or hypothesis testing.
risks: Entry-level assistant role is not aligned with researcher's career stage (MSc graduate) or research identity (HCI researcher, not systems engineer).
Technology stack (web development, traffic simulation) represents a departure from XR and immersive-systems expertise.
Six-month engagement is too brief to substantially advance either technical or research capabilities.
Working as an assistant on someone else's project offers limited autonomy or research ownership.
Position may be perceived as a step backward relative to independent research contribution expected at doctoral level.
